summary: Fixed MatchSession.StartPractice (shared file) hardcoding seed 20260906 on every Practice match, making every game deal an identical order despite the shuffle algorithm itself being correct. Now generates a fresh random seed per call via RandomNumberGenerator, matching RoomManager.cs's existing per-room randomness.
